run_entropy_analysis: run the entro.py module with -inputJson and -outputDir args to compute answer entropy stats
compute_entropy: compute the normalized entropy of a probability distribution using computeEntropy function
compute_answer_distribution: compute answer frequency distribution and entropy for a single question using computeAnswerDistributionForSingleQuestion
compute_all_question_distribution: compute answer distributions and entropy across all questions using computeAnswerDistributionForAllQuestions
collapse_question_type: collapse granular question types into broader categories using the collapseType function
